note: Resort in the pines 5 miles south of Sturgis, under 2 minutes from I-90 Exit 37, backing onto Black Hills National Forest. Pool, hot tubs, beer garden and game room; luxury sites have cement slabs, gas grills and, on the spa sites, a private hot tub. No wood fires (propane and charcoal only). Monthly sites are sold all year outside Rally week. It sits less than a mile from Bulldog Creek Campground, a separate business - the two are easy to conflate on a map. --Claude
